## Problem and accepted outcome

The simplified README preserved the three-document model but removed too much
reader-facing context. The templates also needed to retain complete applicable
information without recreating duplicate documents. The accepted outcome was a
persuasive, navigable project guide; exactly three comprehensive templates;
necessary complexity only; and canonical tracked state that is already current
when a reviewed pull request merges.

## Concluded design

| Design point | Accepted outcome | Boundary or rationale | Delivery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D01 | Open with a concise explanation of the problem, audience, core promise, and capabilities | Readers understand why the project matters before implementation detail | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D02 | Provide nested navigation with resolvable titles and subtitles | The long-form guide remains scannable | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D03 | Explain the core goals and three-document model while linking canonical policy | README teaches; policy remains authoritative | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D04 | Explain major feature areas with useful diagrams | Visual readers can understand adoption through cleanup | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D05 | Connect reduced effort with retained reliability | Efficiency does not remove quality or authority gates | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D06 | Preserve the latest-only simplified model | No obsolete version history, duplicate ledgers, or fixed execution script | [PRs #72–#74](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/74) |
| D07 | Make the guide compelling and clear enough to try | Review explicitly considers interest, clarity, and hesitation | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D08 | License the project under Apache License 2.0 | Public trial and reuse have explicit permission | [PR #72](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/72) |
| D09 | Keep exactly three durable templates with complete proportional information | Consolidation preserves discovery, design, contracts, tasks, validation, recovery, and completion | [PR #73](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/73) |
| D10 | Retain useful outcomes from removed guidance without restoring procedural documents | Readiness, measurement, validation, and uncertain-effect safety remain concise | [PR #74](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/74) |
| D11 | Require only complexity that protects an accepted outcome or invariant | Agents avoid over-engineering while retaining stable results | [PR #74](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/74) |
| D12 | Converge affected tracked canonical state before final PR review | A merge leaves current state; live review, merge, and target evidence stay in GitHub | [PR #77](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/77) |
